morbi.headline: Morbi ceramics benefit from falling freight rates and improved fuel substitution options.
what_changed: Units are shifting away from Piped Natural Gas (PNG) as propane supply improves.
Ocean container freight rates for exported ceramics dropped by up to 50 percent.
Major player Somany Ceramics plans a 5 MSM capacity increase via debottlenecking.
improvement_signals: Propane availability has improved, allowing ceramic units to cut PNG consumption and manage fuel expenses [81469af468f3]
Container freight rates plummeted up to 50 percent, providing significant margin relief for exporters [d6c30857de2c]
what_to_watch: Exact price differential between PNG and propane to gauge working capital adjustments.
Target location and funding mix of Somany Ceramics' 5 MSM debottlenecking plan [0f642d309dd8].
Sustainability of lower ocean freight tariffs across key international trade lanes.

surat.headline: Surat shows divergence: diamond demand revives despite rough shortages, while textiles face sluggishness.
what_changed: Diamond demand is recovering after a four-year slump, leading to early unit reopenings post-vacation.
MMF textile demand lags behind diamonds during the Diwali season, prompting price hikes and strict payment terms by printing associations.
Textile trade faces heightened governance with capacity database drives, fire safety checks, and anti-fraud law demands.
stress_signals: Textile printing units face liquidity stress, enforcing a 15% post-Diwali price hike and 45-day payment caps [ad48975ddfcf].
Organized textile fraud gangs are causing financial defaults, prompting SGCCI to seek strict GUJCTOC enforcement [421d4bf835f5].
Rough diamond shortages are causing forced early pre-Diwali closures of cutting and polishing units [b65b93c4b724].
Individual business stress highlighted by the suicide of a local diamond merchant [9edf027a29a8].
improvement_signals: Diamond jewellery trade reports demand recovery and plans early reopening of polishing units [bae3b8d48691, d6a824e747af, bd78e4a130ff].
Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units representing Rs 1,521 crore in investment [021c037e28d9].
SGCCI signed two MoUs in Morocco to expand export opportunities for Surat textiles [472a28abf217].
what_to_watch: Monitoring rough diamond inventory supply to assess operational continuity of polishing units.
Adherence to the 45-day payment rule in textile printing to gauge working capital health.
Impact of the Textile Ministry's capacity database drive on compliance and operational reporting.
